steps.expectation: each of 100 retained blocks of 65536 bytes adds exactly 65536 bytes and one block
steps.name: retain

steps.expectation: releasing every retained block returns the live bytes and blocks exactly to where they began
steps.name: release

steps.expectation: each of 100 closures leaked with forget() adds at least the 4096 bytes it captures, the live bytes never fall, the extra is at most 256 bytes a closure on average, and none comes back
steps.name: leaked closure

steps.expectation: 100 calls of the library's svg_buttons::watch, which leaks two closures each, add bytes on every call, the live bytes never fall, and removing the element gives none back
steps.name: library leak

steps.expectation: a vector grown a byte at a time, which reallocates many times, is counted at its capacity as one block, and released exactly
steps.name: reallocation

steps.expectation: 25 rounds of retain and release each return exactly to the start, so nothing drifts or counts twice
steps.name: repeated release

steps.expectation: the linear memory is at least as large as the most that was ever live
steps.name: capacity
